findings.finding: Listed holding-company consolidated Japanese GAAP; quarter 2026-04-01 to 2026-06-30. Banking and leasing segments both described. Do not replace group scope with a single operating bank.

Lending/securities interest and bank segment earnings are described; deposits and lending appear on the consolidated balance sheet. This issuer evidence supports financial-equity model review beyond the catalog industry hint.

Deposit interest is within funding costs in ordinary expenses. Under adopted Damodaran financial-service principles, customer funding cannot be treated as ordinary industrial financing debt without adaptation.

Cover accounting equity ratio8.0% is explicitly NOT the ratio specified under the capital-adequacy notice. Do not use it as a regulatory capital requirement, regulatory headroom or target. Current regulatory framework/required capital/growth-distribution constraint remains unverified within four pages.
